name: Mayank Ranghadiya
title: Head of Engineering · Founding Platform Engineer
headline: Platform engineer with 7+ years building distributed systems, AI governance infrastructure and high-traffic Python platforms.
summary: Motivated Platform Engineer with 7+ years of experience in Python, Celery, REST APIs and React. Optimized system performance (30% less processing time on key projects) and delivered 0→1 scalable solutions for high-traffic applications. Built distributed systems processing 300K+ events/min for 1M+ users while orchestrating 7K+ jobs/day. Mentors engineers and drives system reliability across cloud and on-prem environments. Currently Head of Engineering at CognitivTrust, building an AI governance platform.

experience.role: Head of Engineering · Founding Platform Engineer

Key technical point of contact for stakeholders, translating business needs into scalable designs.

projects.name: Agent Town Portfolio
projects.summary: This site: a 3D town of AI agents that answer questions about Mayank's work and assess fit against a job description.
projects.details: Each agent (concierge, career, projects, services, research) is grounded in a structured copy of my CV. Replies come from an LLM on Groq when available, then a deterministic CV knowledge base, then PyBot, a rule-based chatbot in plain Python, so the chat keeps working without any API key.

projects.name: AI Governance Gateway (CognitivTrust)
projects.summary: Zero-config gateway that intercepts IDE-generated AI requests for real-time policy enforcement, with a context layer built from org documents.
projects.details: Routes AI traffic from developer IDEs through a policy engine, augments prompts with organizational policies and release rules, and gives teams monitoring and control over AI-assisted development. Proprietary, so details are high level.
